proofs.text: Run drift with the role `qa`; verify the report's role reads `qa` and that its view carries exactly the keys `audit`, `manual`, `review_list_size`, `rules_without_a_negative_case` and `signatures_stale`

rule_text: A role argument narrows the answer to `since`, `role`, `view` and `commits`, and nothing else

tests.body:
def test_a_role_narrows_the_report(self, project):
        report = json.loads(purlin_drift.drift(project.root, since='1',
                                               role='qa'))
        assert report['role'] == 'qa'
        assert sorted(report['view']) == [
            'audit', 'manual', 'review_list_size',
            'rules_without_a_negative_case', 'signatures_stale']
tests.name: test_a_role_narrows_the_report
